tasks.goal: Persist connector run summaries and rejected-record reasons with immutable IDs; add replayable tests and migration evidence.
Add bounded retry attempt telemetry using low-cardinality error types, resend count, source, and run correlation without secrets.
Add governed public connectors for weather, disaster, and geospatial feeds using explicit license metadata, schemas, fixtures, and source-health monitoring.
Expand entity resolution into a governed ontology with temporal aliases, evidence-backed matches, and uncertainty-preserving identifiers.
Expose a read-only temporal world-state query API with as-of time, evidence references, contradiction visibility, and authorization boundaries.
Add end-to-end replay, provenance, contradiction, stale-data, outage, schema-drift, and performance acceptance suites.
Add persistent queue/stream integration, deployment manifests, health/readiness, backup/recovery procedures, and operational runbooks.
Build evidence-first analyst queries, map views, timelines, and derived-event workflows without allowing unverified AI claims into authoritative state.
